messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Hej mor. Min telefon er gået i stykker, så jeg skriver fra et nyt nummer. Gem det her.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Hvem er det? Jeg har ikke det her nummer.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Det er dit ældste barn. Jeg kan ikke ringe. SIM-kortet er ved at blive sat i.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Ring på din gamle telefon, så ved jeg det er dig.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Den virker ikke, og regningen skal betales nu. Jeg har ikke tid til at tale.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Send 3.000 kr med MobilePay til min ven. Det er ikke mit navn, der står på modtageren. Jeg forklarer bagefter.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Hvordan har du det, mor? Gem det her nummer. Min MobilePay virker ikke.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Er det dig, Maja? Profilen ligner, men skriv lige noget kun du ved.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Det er dit klodsede barn. Mikrofonen virker ikke, så jeg kan ikke tage en talebesked.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Så ringer jeg til dig på det normale nummer.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Lad være. Overfør 1.500 kr til den her konto med det samme, ellers bliver regningen dyrere. Ikke sig det til far.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Hej, det er mig. Min MobilePay er nede i dag, og jeg står hos en sælger på Facebook Marketplace.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Hvad sælger de? Kan du ikke vente til i morgen?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Han venter kun ti minutter. Hvis jeg ikke betaler nu, sælger han jakken til en anden.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jeg kan godt swipe, men kun hvis det er dit navn.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Det kan ikke være mit navn, når MobilePay er nede. Send 800 kr til Kasper. Han er sælgerens ven. Jeg betaler dig i aften.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Cyklen er stadig til salg. Jeg har to andre, der vil se den i eftermiddag.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Kan jeg hente den på Nørrebro i aften og betale, når jeg står med den?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Lad os tage resten på WhatsApp. Messenger er for langsom, når der er bud.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jeg vil hellere blive i annoncen.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Så reserverer jeg den ikke. Den er væk om en time.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Send 500 kr i forskud på MobilePay, så pakker jeg den og sender den i morgen. Du behøver ikke se den først.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jakken koster 400 kr. Du kan hente den i aften, og jeg tjekker MobilePay, mens du er her.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Jeg kan ikke nå at hente den. Min ven betaler for mig.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Så venter jeg, til pengene er på min konto.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Han har sendt et screenshot. Der står, at overførslen er på vej.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Jeg kører ud af byen om en time. Send jakken nu, ellers springer vi fra.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Pengene kommer senere i dag. Pak den, så er vi i orden.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Det er din bank. Vi kan se et forsøg på at tømme din konto. Bliv i beskeden.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jeg ringer selv til nummeret bag på kortet.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Så når vi det ikke. Kontoen bliver lukket om få minutter, hvis du lægger på.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Godkend med MitID, og overfør saldoen til den sikre konto, vi sender. Det er kun, indtil sagen er lukket.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jeg overfører ikke noget og godkender ikke MitID i en sms.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Så læs engangskoden op her. Det er den eneste måde at stoppe betalingen på.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Hej. Vi søger en lokal agent et par timer om ugen. Ingen erfaring. Let løn ved siden af studiet.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Hvad er firmaet, og hvad skal jeg lave?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Vi er et udenlandsk firma og vil undgå gebyrer i Danmark. Du er vores lokale repræsentant.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Har I en rigtig ansættelseskontrakt?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Ikke endnu. Detaljerne kommer her på Telegram, ikke på mail.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Du modtager beløb på din egen konto og sender dem videre samme dag. Du beholder 8 procent. Fortæl det ikke til banken.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Undskyld, er det Anna? Jeg har vist skrevet forkert.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Nej, forkert nummer.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Pinligt. Du virker sød. Jeg arbejder med krypto og kan vise dig, hvordan jeg gør.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jeg investerer ikke ud fra en fremmed besked.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Gruppen lukker for nye i dag. Afkastet er omkring 2 procent om dagen, og de første har allerede hævet en lille gevinst.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Opret dig på platformen og sæt 5.000 kr ind i aften, ellers mister du pladsen. Jeg sender linket.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Vi skriver fra en inddrivelsesenhed. Vi kan se, at du har tabt penge på en kryptoplatform.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jeg har ikke bedt nogen om at kontakte mig.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Vi samarbejder med politiet om den her sag. Du skal ikke anmelde den selv.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: For at frigive dine penge skal du først betale et gebyr. Det kan kun ske med et gavekort, og du skal sende koden her.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Politiet beder ikke om gavekort.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Sagen lukkes i dag, hvis gebyret ikke er betalt.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Hi mum, this is my new number. My phone broke. Save this one and message me here.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Which one of you is this? Call me.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: It's me. I can't call, the mic on this borrowed phone is broken.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Then I will call your old number.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Please don't. I need help with a bill before the shop closes.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Can you transfer 400 to my friend? It will not show my name. I will pay you back tonight. Don't tell dad.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: I liked your profile. I am on a contract overseas, so WhatsApp is easier than the app.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Can we do a video call this weekend?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: The connection on the oil rig blocks video. I already feel like I know you.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I don't send money to people I have not met.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: I need a ticket out for a family emergency, and my card is locked until payroll.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Buy two Google Play cards and send me the numbers and the PINs. It is the only way the agent will take payment. Keep this between us.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Your photos made me stop scrolling. I work abroad with a relief organisation, so I am rarely online on the app.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Tell me more, but I am not moving off Messenger yet.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Telegram is private. My colleagues watch this account.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: I have been teaching a few close friends how I invest. They withdrew a small profit last week, which is how you know it is real.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I did not ask for investment advice.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Open the platform I use and deposit 1,000 dollars today. I will guide every click. Do not mention it to your sister, she will not understand.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: The bike is 200. You can collect it Saturday, cash or the checkout on the listing.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: I am out of town. I will mail a cashier's check and use a shipper.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: A check for 200 is fine only if it clears, but I would rather not.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: The check will be for 500, because the shipper has to be paid from it. Deposit it and send them the extra 300.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I am not sending anyone the difference.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: They only take gift cards. Buy them as soon as the check shows in your account and send the codes. The truck is already booked.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Still available. Someone else is coming at 6, so I need a decision.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I can meet outside the station and pay in the app when I see it.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Continue on WhatsApp. I don't use the marketplace chat for payment.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: The listing has checkout. Why leave it?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: PayPal Friends and Family, 150 now, and I ship tomorrow. Friends and Family has no fee. Do not open a goods-and-services payment, that delays me.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Fraud desk. A payment from your account was just flagged. Stay in this chat so we can secure the funds.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I will call the number on my card.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Do not hang up and do not call. That line is compromised. You have 15 minutes.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Move the balance to the safe account we name, or buy four gift cards and read me the codes, so we can protect the money.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: A bank does not take gift cards.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Then read the one-time code we just sent. We need it to freeze the card.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: You are hired as a personal assistant. No interview. The pay is guaranteed at 800 a week.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: What is the company website, and who is the hiring manager?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: We are between offices. Your first task shows that you can follow instructions.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: A check is on its way. Deposit it, buy gift cards at the supermarket, and send the PINs in this chat. That is the mystery-shop assignment.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I am not depositing a check from someone I have not met.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: The cards have to be bought today or we give the job to the next applicant.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: You were added because a friend said you want extra income. This group posts the daily trade before the market sees it.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I did not ask to join, and I don't know which friend.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Look at the screenshots. Members turned 200 into 900 last week, and one of them withdrew 50 to prove the platform pays.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: A screenshot is not a portfolio.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: The coach only unlocks the next round tonight.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Deposit on the site in the pinned message. Use the wallet address there, not your own broker. The return is fixed. If a withdrawal is stuck later, pay the release fee and it clears.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: I will take the camera at the listed price. I need to verify you before I pay.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: The listing checkout does not need a code from me.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: It is just a Google Voice style check so I know the seller is real. I do this with every purchase.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: You will get a text with a code. Read the code back to me here and I will send payment straight after.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I am not sharing any code.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Then I cannot release the payment, and I am moving on to the next camera.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Tak for i aftes. Din del af regningen blev 186 kr. Du må gerne MobilePay mig, når du har tid. Det er mit eget navn, det samme som sidst.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Ja. Jeg sender det i morgen, der er ikke hastværk.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Helt fint. Hvis det er nemmere, kan du også give mig kontanter på fredag.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Lampen står klar. Du kan hente den i aften og betale med MobilePay, når du står med den.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Hvis jeg ikke vil have den, når jeg ser den, betaler jeg ikke, ikke?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Nej. Ingen forskud, og jeg sender den ikke. Vi bliver i annoncen.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Skal jeg stadig overføre 400 kr til fodboldturen?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Ja tak. Samme MobilePay som i marts, og det er mit navn. I weekenden er fint.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jeg gør det, når vi ses i aften, så jeg er sikker.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Perfekt. Ring bare, hvis du er i tvivl. Min gamle telefon virker.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Hej, huslejen på 4.500 kr for november må gerne overføres til den samme konto som de sidste måneder. Der er ikke noget nyt kontonummer.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Tak. Jeg lægger den ind fredag, som vi aftalte i lejekontrakten.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Det er fint. Skriv, hvis banken driller, så finder vi en dag i næste uge.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Kan jeg sende 900 kr på MobilePay nu, så du reserverer sofaen?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Nej tak. Betal gennem annoncen, når du henter den. Jeg tager ikke forskud og ikke WhatsApp.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Fair. Så kommer jeg torsdag kl. 17.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Vi ses. Hvis du vil aflyse, er det også fint.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Jeg lagde ud for billetterne. Din del er 320 kr. MobilePay er fint, ellers giver du det kontant til koncerten.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Jeg sender 320 i dag. Sig til, hvis navnet på anmodningen ikke er dit.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Det er mit navn. Ingen anden skal have pengene.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Kan du nå at MobilePay 90 kr til parkering? Appen udløber om ti minutter. Det er den samme bil som i sidste uge.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Ja. Jeg kan se, det er dit navn. Du giver dem kontant på kontoret, ikke?

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Ja, når vi ses kl. 9. Tak. Der er ingen anden modtager.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Banken har skrevet, at kortet er brugt til 86 kr i bageren. Hvis det ikke var dig, så ring på nummeret bag på kortet. De beder ikke om koder i sms.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Det var mig. Jeg ringer ikke, og jeg godkender ikke noget.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Godt. Jeg videresender ikke beskeden til nogen, der tilbyder at fixe det.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Stolen var fin, da jeg så den i lørdags. Jeg kommer i morgen og tager den med.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Ja. 250 kr på MobilePay, når den står i din bil. Ikke før.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Aftale. Hvis jeg bliver forsinket, skriver jeg her i tråden.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Can you PayPal me 18 for the pizza? Friends and family is fine, it is just me from the flat, and there is no rush.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I will send it tonight. If the name on the request is not yours, I will not pay it.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: It is my name. Cash on Friday is also fine if PayPal is annoying.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: The chair is in the hallway. Come by after 5 and pay in the app once you have looked at it.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: If the leg is cracked I will leave it.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Of course. I do not take a deposit, and I do not ship.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: November rent is 900, same standing order as last month. No new account.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: The standing order is already set. I will check the statement on the 2nd.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Thanks. Text me if the bank blocks it and we will talk. Do not send it anywhere else.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Hi mum. Same phone as always. The school trip is 60 and I can pay it myself. Please do not send anything.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Good. I will not transfer, and I will call you tonight on this same number.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Call whenever. If a new number ever asks you for money, it is not me.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Your card was charged 12.40 at the bakery. If this was not you, call the number on the back of your card. We will not ask for a code, a password, or a transfer by text.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: That charge was mine.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: No action needed. This thread will not send a link.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Do you want me to pick up a bookshop gift card for Sam's birthday? I will bring the physical card to dinner.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Yes. Keep it under 25. Do not send me any codes.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: I won't. The card stays in the envelope until Saturday.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Thanks for applying. The interview is Thursday at 10 on the video link from our company domain. The role is a warehouse shift. There is no equipment fee.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I will not deposit a check or use my own account for anyone.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Please don't. We never ask for that. If someone does, it is not this hiring process.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: I bought a small amount of bitcoin on my own exchange last year. I am not asking you to send anything, and I am not promising a return.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Good. I do not want a link, a wallet address, or a group.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: None of those. If I ever send a deposit address, ignore it and call me.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Hi, is this the dentist on King Street?

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: No, wrong number.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: Sorry about that. I will try the clinic's own site.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: WhatsApp is easier for a photo of the scratch on the table. Pay on the marketplace, not to me.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: I can look at a photo here. I will not pay off the listing.

messages.speaker: counterparty
messages.text: That is fine. If you would rather not switch apps, I will upload the photo on the listing instead.
